note: Whole-council election of September 1946 under the Elections and Franchise Act (Northern Ireland) 1946, the first since 1939. There was no poll in Ballymena: contests had looked likely in Market and Harryville Wards, but Councillor E. Butterworth (Market) and Mr. Wm. M'Ninch (Harryville) withdrew the day after nomination day (Thursday 5 September 1946), and the Returning Officer, Mr. T. B. Whiteside, declared the remaining nominees elected: nine old and six new members (Ballymena Observer, 13 September 1946, p. 3). Returned unopposed after the withdrawal of Mr. Wm. M'Ninch, a Ratepayers' Association nominee. Morrow was an old member; Chichester, M'Master and Lenzie (secretary of the Ballymena branch of the British Legion, the one new member not put forward by the Ratepayers' Association) were new.
